title: "V4003 or_pattern_bindings"
description: "All alternatives of an or-pattern must bind the same names with the same types (design §3.2)."

An error from the `pattern` phase. `sakura explain V4003` prints this explanation offline.

All alternatives of an or-pattern must bind the same names with the same types (design §3.2).
Bind the name in every alternative, replace it with `_`, or split the alternatives into arms.

Wrong:

```sakura
(x, 0) | (0, _) => 1
```

Fixed:

```sakura
(_, 0) | (0, _) => 1
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V4003_or_pattern_bindings.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V4003_or_pattern_bindings.sakura), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn pick(p: (Int, Int)) -> Int {
  match p {
    (x, 0) | (0, _) => 1,
    _ => 0,
  }
}
```
